pages.text: Some ogres carry relics that fit Curios slots. Hover each trophy here to inspect its full production tooltip and slot information.$(br2)These are creature spoils rather than crafting projects; seek the ogre whose habits match the relic.

pages.title: Strength & Stubbornness
pages.text: Grunts may carry necklaces; Brutes may leave hearts. Bog Iron Bands rest in Ogre strongholds.

pages.title: Fog & Arrows
pages.text: Mages and Archers are the respective sources of these specialized relics.
